description: Zero-shot classification task: send text (max 8,000 chars) and 2-50 labels; get one label (or every applicable label with multi_label=true) guaranteed to be from your list, plus a one-sentence reason. Invalid output → 422, not charged. Runs on our Cloudflare Worker using Workers AI (IBM Granite 4.0 micro, Apache-2.0). No calibrated probabilities. Limited daily capacity: 503 (not charged) when used up. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402 (MCP transport: an unpaid call returns the x402 PaymentRequired object; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over HTTP: POST /api/ai/classify.
name: ai_classify
title: Zero-shot text classification into your labels (intent, sentiment, topic, routing)
